__purpose: 示例关键术语列表 — 用于 §4.2.2 KTRR 关键术语保留率计算
__purpose_en: Example Key Terms List — for §4.2.2 Key Term Retention Rate (KTRR) Calculation
__source: 通过 TF-IDF 从机器学习课程逐字稿中提取的 30 个领域关键术语
__source_en: 30 domain key terms extracted from machine learning lecture transcript via TF-IDF

__format_notes.rule_1: 每个术语应为一个独立的领域关键词，不包含标点符号
__format_notes.rule_1_en: Each term should be a standalone domain keyword, without punctuation
__format_notes.rule_2: 建议同时包含中英文版本，以覆盖不同语言的 STT 输出
__format_notes.rule_2_en: It is recommended to include both Chinese and English versions to cover different STT output languages
__format_notes.rule_3: 术语总数建议 20-30 个，通过 TF-IDF 或专家标注确定
__format_notes.rule_3_en: Recommended total: 20-30 terms, determined via TF-IDF or expert annotation
__format_notes.rule_4: 评估时使用模糊匹配（允许 1 字符编辑距离的中文容错）
__format_notes.rule_4_en: Fuzzy matching is used during evaluation (1-character edit distance tolerance for Chinese)
